trigger: User requests 3-character public slugs, optional ranking participant counts, and meaningful multi-exam comparison on shared pages.
principles: Public share slugs should be easy to type: 3-50 chars, lowercase letters/numbers/hyphens, uppercase normalized to lowercase, no leading/trailing hyphen.
A ranking may be useful even when the total participant count is unknown; participant counts are optional.
Percentile is shown only when both rank and participant count are known.
Sharing multiple exams must communicate trajectory, not merely dump historical rows.
Relative school position is the primary comparison signal; raw score is secondary because exam difficulty changes.
Do not expose notes or any fields the family did not choose to share.

tasks.text: Public slugs now accept 3-50 letters/digits/hyphens, normalize uppercase to lowercase, and only forbid leading/trailing hyphens.
Ranking participant counts are optional in the model, editor and display; rank-only values remain visible and percentile is omitted until population is known.
Shared multi-exam history is now a chronological comparison with school-position priority, exam summary cards and subject score trajectories when shared.
Added model, Worker integration and UI contract regressions; bumped package/runtime to 0.1.3.
